description: List LIVE findings (observed gaps/debt with no fix yet — triage open/accepted-risk/scheduled) for a file, glob, or symbol; omit scope for the whole ledger. Call before planning work in an area to inherit past audits instead of re-discovering them. Lists each finding's first sentence; pass id for one finding's full observation. Advisory; resolved/stale findings are excluded unless all:true. Not for invariants (hunch_check_constraints) or bug history (hunch_bug_lineage): findings are observations, never rules.

id.description: one finding id (fnd_*) — returns its full observation, whatever its triage; scope/all/limit are ignored

scope.description: a path, glob, or symbol (e.g. src/procs/** or dbo.GetOrders); omit for all

name: hunch_findings
title: Open findings for a scope
